description:
FHA & VA Approved! Tucked behind the gates of one of Woodland Hills’ most recognizable resort communities lies an opportunity to experience the lifestyle buyers search for but rarely find at this price point. Welcome to life at The Met.
Perched on the top floor, this highly sought-after Expanded 2E floor plan offers a combination of openness, privacy, and functionality that has made it one of the community’s most desirable layouts. Vaulted ceilings create an immediate sense of volume and natural light while the thoughtfully designed floor plan provides the flexibility modern living demands. Whether enjoying a quiet evening at home or entertaining friends, the space feels open, comfortable, and intentionally designed for everyday living.
Features include private in-unit laundry, stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, convenient proximity to the elevator, and two covered parking spaces, combining practicality with convenience rarely found in condominium living.
Beyond your front door is where The Met truly separates itself. Spread across 26 acres of lush, manicured grounds, residents enjoy an environment that feels more like a private resort getaway than a residential community. Spend weekends enjoying one of four sparkling pools, challenge friends on one of six lighted tennis courts, work out in the state-of-the-art fitness center, play indoor basketball or racquetball, or simply enjoy the peace of living within a guard-gated community designed around lifestyle and convenience.
Location matters, and few locations continue to evolve like Warner Center. Positioned in the center of one of Los Angeles’ fastest growing live-work-play districts, residents enjoy close proximity to shopping, dining, entertainment, parks, major employers, public transportation, and easy freeway access. As Warner Center continues its transformation, buyers aren’t simply purchasing real estate, they’re investing in a lifestyle and a location with long-term appeal.
For first-time buyers, downsizers, investors, or anyone seeking low-maintenance living without sacrificing amenities, this is more than a condominium. This is resort living in the heart of Woodland Hills.
